title: magnifier widget
explanation:
### Description

Demonstrate vtkMagnifierWidget and vtkMagnifierRepresentation on a mace geometry.

**dataset → input → filter → visual_asset → renderer → infrastructure → scene → output**

- [vtkActor](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkActor.html) — assigns the mapped geometry to the scene.
- [vtkConeSource](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkConeSource.html) — generates a polygonal cone.
- [vtkFeatureEdges](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkFeatureEdges.html) — feature edges.
- [vtkGlyph3D](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkGlyph3D.html) — places oriented, scaled glyphs at each point.
- [vtkMagnifierRepresentation](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkMagnifierRepresentation.html) — magnifier representation.
- [vtkMagnifierWidget](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkMagnifierWidget.html) — magnifier widget.
- [vtkPolyDataMapper](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkPolyDataMapper.html) — maps polygonal data to graphics primitives.
- [vtkSphereSource](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkSphereSource.html) — generates a tessellated sphere.
- [vtkRenderWindow](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkRenderWindow.html) — displays the rendered scene in a window on screen.
- [vtkRenderWindowInteractor](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkRenderWindowInteractor.html) — captures mouse and keyboard events.
- [vtkRenderer](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkRenderer.html) — assembles the scene and configures the camera.
- `Initialize()` and `Start()` launch the interactive visualization — `Initialize()` prepares the interactor and `Start()` begins the event loop.
